metadata.description_html:
Welcome to Copy to Color by The Pivot Kids! The perfect early learning activity book designed to help young artists develop fine motor control, color recognition, and hand-eye coordination.

Why Children and Parents Love This Book:

  • Color & Copy Dual-Guide Layout: Every activity page features a vibrant, full-color reference guide alongside an exactly matched, bold black-and-white coloring outline. Little ones can look, match, and color with confidence!
  • 30 Unique Educational Themes: Features 30 curated, age-appropriate illustrations with zero duplicate subjects.
  • Chunky Bold Contours: Designed specifically for little hands (ages 3–5) with thick, crisp contours and wide colorable areas.
  • Single-Page Learning Chrome: Includes educational letter and index code badges, custom subject banners, and celebratory completion badges.
  • Official Super Colorist Award: Includes an official completion certificate on Page 32 celebrating your little artist's achievement!

Book Specifications:

  • Trim Size: 8.5 x 11.0 inches (Large, comfortable coloring canvas)
  • Page Count: Exactly 32 pages
  • Age Recommendation: 3 to 5 years (Toddlers, Preschool, Kindergarten)
  • Publisher Imprint: The Pivot Digital Publication

Collect all 12 volumes in the Copy to Color series and inspire a lifelong love of creative coloring!
